text.en: For a hollandaise kind of sauce, use the butter warm, not hot.
text.de: Für eine Sauce nach Art der Hollandaise die Butter warm verwenden, nicht heiß.

why.en: Hot butter cooks the egg yolks further.
why.de: Heiße Butter gart das Eigelb weiter.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 1.8 Hollandaise Based Sauces, section Temperatures and Sanitation Concerns
sources.sentence: The clarified butter used to make the sauce should be warm but not so hot as to further cook the egg yolks.
